title: The Shawshank Redemption
description: Andy Dufresne, wrongly imprisoned for murder, spends decades finding hope and freedom inside Shawshank prison. Widely considered one of the greatest films ever made.

title: Forrest Gump
description: A kind-hearted man with a low IQ accidentally becomes part of every major American event of the 20th century. Tom Hanks won the Oscar for this beloved epic.

title: Pulp Fiction
description: Quentin Tarantino's crime classic. Intertwining stories of hitmen, a boxer and a briefcase in Los Angeles — with dialogue that changed cinema.

title: Fight Club
description: A nameless narrator and the charismatic Tyler Durden start an underground fight club that grows into something far more dangerous. The first rule: don't talk about it.

title: The Dark Knight Rises
description: Eight years after Harvey Dent's death, Batman is forced out of retirement when the masked terrorist Bane threatens Gotham. Nolan's trilogy finale.

title: Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back
description: The Empire hunts the rebels across the galaxy. Luke trains with Yoda and faces the most famous reveal in cinema history.

title: Star Wars: Return of the Jedi
description: The final chapter of the original trilogy. Luke faces Darth Vader and the Emperor as the rebels attack the second Death Star.

title: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
description: An orphan discovers he is a wizard and enters Hogwarts, where he must stop a plot to steal a legendary stone. Where the Wizarding World began.

title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows – Part 2
description: The final battle of Hogwarts. Harry faces Voldemort in the epic conclusion of the eight-film saga.

title: Jurassic Park
description: Dinosaurs are brought back to life on a theme park island — until everything goes terrifyingly wrong. Spielberg's groundbreaking blockbuster.

title: Gladiator
description: A betrayed Roman general becomes a gladiator and fights his way back to Rome for revenge against the emperor who destroyed his family.

title: Coco
description: A boy who dreams of music enters the Land of the Dead on Día de los Muertos and uncovers his family's hidden history. Pixar's love letter to Mexico.

title: Frozen II
description: Elsa follows a mysterious voice into an enchanted forest to discover the truth about her powers and her family's past.

title: Encanto
description: In a magical Colombian family, the only ordinary member — Mirabel — must save the family's miracle when the magic begins to fade.

title: Big Hero 6
description: A robotics prodigy and his inflatable healthcare robot Baymax team up with fellow tech geniuses to fight a masked villain in San Fransokyo.

title: Wreck-It Ralph
description: A video-game villain who wants to be a hero travels between arcade games and discovers he's the good guy all along.

title: Tangled
description: A princess with magical 70 feet of hair escapes her tower with a charming thief. Disney's retelling of Rapunzel.

title: Shrek
description: A grumpy ogre's swamp is invaded by fairy-tale creatures, so he makes a deal to rescue a princess — and finds love along the way.

title: Madagascar
description: Four New York Zoo animals are shipwrecked on Madagascar and discover the wild life they never knew they wanted.

title: Kung Fu Panda
description: A lazy, overweight panda is chosen as the Dragon Warrior and must learn kung fu to defend the Valley of Peace.

title: The Super Mario Bros. Movie
description: Brooklyn plumbers Mario and Luigi are transported to the Mushroom Kingdom, where Mario must save the world from Bowser.

title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
description: Miles Morales travels across the multiverse and meets an army of Spider-People — including a society that has other plans for him.

title: The Wild Robot
description: A shipwrecked robot named Roz learns to survive on a wild island and becomes the adoptive mother of a gosling. DreamWorks' animated masterpiece.

title: Puss in Boots: The Last Wish
description: With eight of his nine lives gone, Puss in Boots embarks on a quest for the mythical Last Wish — with Death itself hunting him.

title: Elemental
description: In a city where fire, water, earth and air people live together, a fire element and a water element discover how much they have in common.

title: Cars
description: A hotshot race car gets stranded in a forgotten Route 66 town and learns what truly matters. Pixar's road-trip classic.

title: Monsters, Inc.
description: Monsters power their city by scaring children — until a human girl wanders into the factory and changes everything.

title: Finding Nemo
description: A clownfish crosses the entire ocean to rescue his son Nemo from a dentist's fish tank. The film that made everyone love Pixar.

title: The Incredibles
description: A family of retired superheroes is forced back into action when a new villain threatens the world.

title: Ratatouille
description: A rat with a gift for cooking teams up with a hapless kitchen boy to become the chef of Paris's finest restaurant.

title: WALL-E
description: A lonely waste-collecting robot on abandoned Earth falls in love and follows a sleek probe robot across the galaxy, carrying the last plant.

title: Up
description: A widower ties thousands of balloons to his house and flies to South America, with an accidental stowaway: a young Wilderness Explorer.

title: Toy Story
description: When a new space-ranger toy threatens his place in the bedroom, cowboy Woody learns what friendship really means. The film that started Pixar.

title: How to Train Your Dragon
description: A Viking boy who doesn't fit in befriends a dragon everyone fears — and changes his world forever. DreamWorks' best.
